name: L-Train Frosted Blunt | Chocolate Thai
description:
L-Train's Frosted 1.5-gram infused blunt is crafted for those who seek an elegantly potent experience. Made with premium real flower, this pre-roll is infused with high-quality bubble hash on the inside and dusted with THCA powder on the outside, delivering a powerful and incomparable effect.

Perfect for experienced users or anyone looking for stronger, longer-lasting relief, these Frosted Blunts is ideal for self-medicating and those who crave a great tasting, potent sensation.
